get.summary: Stats, the filtered applications (all, or one status) and the form pickers.
One application with every field (Aadhaar masked).

delete.summary: Approved applications stay as the artisan's registration record; the rest can be deleted.

post.summary: Takes a new application up for review by the current admin.
Registers the applicant as an ACTIVE artisan and, when a vacant stall is chosen, allots it.
Rejects an open application; remarks are required.

get.summary: Stats, the status chart, the filtered directory and the form pickers. stall = assigned / unassigned.
Profile: details, stall, and this month's sales at that stall.

delete.summary: An artisan holding a stall cannot be deleted; open reallocation requests naming them are closed.

get.summary: A day's sheet (default today), its counts, the week strip and each department's figures.

post.summary: Saves the marked rows of a day's sheet: a record already saved for that staff and date is updated, others are added.

get.summary: Saved records for from..to when given, otherwise the month (yyyy-MM), otherwise the current month.
The month's calendar (default this month); type = designation, status = a status or NOT_MARKED.

post.summary: Signs in and returns the bearer token to send as "Authorization: Bearer {token}".
Ends this device's session; the token stops working.

get.summary: The signed-in user and how long the session has left.

post.summary: "Stay signed in": counts as activity and returns how long the session now has left.

get.summary: The user's own sessions; an admin also gets everyone's active sessions.

delete.summary: Ends one session: any of your own, or (admins) anyone's.

post.summary: Signs out every other device and browser where this account is signed in.
Starts a password reset. The answer is the same whether or not the account exists.
Sets a new password with the emailed token; every session of the account is signed out.

get.summary: Header cards, sales trend (days = 40, 90 or 180), occupancy, category sales, stall ranking, low stock and recent activity.
The applications behind an overview widget: APPROVED (this month), UNDER_REVIEW or PENDING.
Stats, categories, the filtered products, low-stock alerts and recent stock movements.

delete.summary: The stock history and sale lines keep their code / name snapshot of the product.

post.summary: ADD / REDUCE by a quantity, or CORRECTION to the counted quantity.

get.summary: Entitlement, taken and balance per employee and leave type.
Staff (with categories) and the year's entitlements, for the entitlement form.

post.summary: Adds or changes an employee's quota for a leave type (in steps of 0.5 days).

get.summary: Active staff, entitlements and the year's leave entries, for the leave-taken form.

post.summary: Records future leave (dates yyyy-MM-dd, this year) against the employee's balance.

get.summary: The month's pay bill; q matches employee name or id.

post.summary: Saves the month's pay bill with the allowances, overtime amounts and deductions given per employee.

get.summary: The employee's saved pay bills before the month, newest first.
KPIs and the overview charts, optionally for one category.
Sales at each artisan's stall: share of all sales and a 1-5 rating against the best seller.
Days worked per staff member; type = designation. Year within the last ten years, default this month.
Salary prorated by days worked; type = department, q matches id, name, department or designation.
The day's head count (default today): artisans, then staff per department with who attended.
One day (yyyy-MM-dd, default today): summary, entries, charts and the product / stall pickers.

put.summary: Only the net change per product touches stock: more sold -> SALE, fewer sold -> SALE_REVERSAL.

delete.summary: Deletes the entry and puts the sold quantities back into stock.

get.summary: Product-wise sales: one row per product per day.
The stock movements written by sales (deductions and reversals), newest first.
At least two characters; three or more digits also match mobile numbers.
Departments, shifts, the filtered staff list and the totals.
Stats, the filtered list, the full map, pickers and reallocation requests.

put.summary: Edits the details; the code is fixed, and an occupied stall stays OCCUPIED (vacate or reallocate instead).

delete.summary: Only a vacant stall without products can be deleted; its reallocation requests go with it.

post.summary: Allots a vacant stall to an artisan who holds none.
Frees an occupied stall; any open reallocation request for it is closed.
Asks for an occupied stall to move to another artisan (or to be vacated when none is named).
Approving moves the stall to the requested artisan, or vacates it when none was named.

role.description: admin, staff or inventory: the role the account signs in with.

rememberMe.description: true: the token lasts Session:RememberMeDays; false: Session:AbsoluteTimeoutHours, ended early by inactivity.
